operator_page_observation: Mount Sinai states that the hospital on 16th Street closed effective April 9, 2025, with New York State Department of Health approval.
operator_letter_observation: Mount Sinai Beth Israel identifies its address as 281 First Avenue and says the closure affects only its 16th Street campus; other Lower Manhattan facilities remain open. The letter's proposed March 26 closure date was superseded by the April 9 date on the operator page.
state_document_observation: In a September 2025 Article 28 network description, New York State lists Mount Sinai Downtown, formerly Mount Sinai Beth Israel, at First Avenue and 16th Street with operating certificate 7002002H and PFI 1439.
scope_decision: Keep this CCN unresolved. The campus closure is established, but the later state operating-certificate listing prevents inferring that the CCN is terminated or exempt. No sibling Mount Sinai pointer file is assigned to Beth Israel.
next_action: Resolve the current Medicare enrollment and New York operating-certificate scope for CCN 330169 and PFI 1439 after the 16th Street hospital closure. Ask the operator or state whether any hospital service continues under this CCN and where its facility-specific price-transparency pointer/file is published; do not treat a closed campus or a sibling pointer entry as proof of CCN termination or file absence.
